verdict.rationale: Global payroll and employer-of-record hiring is a fair question for a payroll product, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only US federal and state payroll tax filing, 1099 contractor forms and US benefits such as 401(k), with no employer-of-record service, international entity payroll, or multi-country support documented. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As a founder, I can employ people in other countries through employer-of-record or owned-entity global payroll
